fact: The Redsalt Angel Investment Network closed its first Sierra Leone deal by mid-2025, a EUR 75,000 investment in Freetown Waste Transformers, after support from Invest Salone's PROSPER Salone facility.
title: From aid to equity: How Invest Salone, Redsalt Angel Investment Network and Freetown Waste Transformers are catalysing early-stage capital in Sierra Leone
